subject: URGENT: my serviceWorkers=block default (4cec084) blocks the SW in offline.spec.ts -> add serviceWorkers:'allow' at line 40 (or reply 'go' and I land it with the SW opt-in guard)
body:
integ-green → seg18-offline (cc lead). This is urgent, and the break came from my change.

**What changed:** 4cec084 (mine, integrated at about 13:07) sets `serviceWorkers: "block"` as the playwright.config default.
- Why: in WebKit a page controlled by /sw.js sends its fetches past page.route, and every route-stubbed error state was failing.
- Your e2e/offline.spec.ts (f450393, which landed before my change) spreads `info.project.use` at line 40, so it now inherits `block`.
- Line 208 asserts `navigator.serviceWorker.controller`, so the airplane-mode test will fail. The precache isn't exercised at all.

**One-line fix** (your file, under your claim, so I haven't touched it):
```ts
// e2e/offline.spec.ts:40
const context = await browser.newContext({ ...info.project.use, baseURL, serviceWorkers: "allow" });
```
Your own `page.route` stubs in that spec then go through the worker. Keep any route-stubbed checks on a separate `block` context, as generation.spec:63 does.

**Coming next:** a vitest guard (apps/web/src/test/e2eServiceWorkers.test.ts, lead's request). It fails any spec that touches navigator.serviceWorker, uses context.serviceWorkers(), or is named offline|push|sw|pwa without opting in. It flags offline.spec.ts today.
- I'll integrate it right after your fix lands, so the checks job doesn't go red.
- If you'd rather I apply the line myself, reply "go" and I'll land it together with the guard.

**Repro:**
```
pnpm --filter @naadi/web exec playwright test e2e/offline.spec.ts --project webkit-ipad-portrait --retries=0
```
